data.description: 清晨五点半的住宅区，她骑着自行车穿梭在还亮着路灯的街道，车筐里整齐码着卷好的报纸；呼出的白气与渐亮的天色，是她不为人知的日常开头。
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane pedals through the residential street at half past five, the front bicycle basket neatly filled with rolled newspapers. Her blue windbreaker, long trousers and practical sneakers follow the motion as her breath condenses in the cold air. The medium view includes handlebars in front and houses receding behind. Gradually brightening dawn lights the street's upper surfaces, while still-glowing lamps cast warmer reflections along the bicycle frame and basket rim.
